entries.2a8df58a46ec61dc: A category that provides AI optimization, SEO and Web site development as a single package. In addition to keyword strategy formulation, optimization of Web site internal structure, content marketing and UI/UX optimization, it provides measures (AIO) aimed at optimizing for search results and answers generated by generative AI, and covers the production of corporate sites and EC sites through to post-launch maintenance and operation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥853 million.
entries.30732398be43f24e: Under the corporate philosophy 'Create services that are useful to customers and society by utilizing web marketing and SalesTech,' the company is centered on the Web Marketing Business and the Cloud SalesTech Business, and is working to strengthen a structure that supports the process from attracting customers to receiving orders and closing deals on a one-stop basis, aiming to become an indispensable company in society.

entries.ff236dde8002160f: Under the corporate philosophy 'Create services that are useful to customers and society by utilizing web marketing and SalesTech,' the company is centered on the Web Marketing Business and the Cloud SalesTech Business, and is working to strengthen a structure that supports the process from attracting customers to receiving orders and closing deals on a one-stop basis, aiming to become an indispensable company in society.
